source: NTSB AAR-15-01, FDR data from section 1.6 and 2.2.1; final data at liftoff and climb

markers.label: Takeoff roll begins; engines at high thrust
Rotation; nose rises to 12° pitch; aircraft lifts off
Gear up commanded; positive climb; pitch 14.5°; altitude 100 ft
Climbing through altitude with high pitch attitude (16°); climb rate 1,200 fpm
Pitch attitude reaches 16.2° (trimmed); airspeed 171 knots; altitude 500 ft; FDR shows steeper climb than previous flight
Pitch attitude continues to increase to 18°; cargo shift causing pitch-up; hydraulic systems damaged
Pitch attitude 22°; aircraft approaching stall; nose rises sharply; roll angle increasing
Aerodynamic stall; aircraft rolls right sharply; vertical velocity reverses to descent
Aircraft descending rapidly at 3,000 fpm in nose-down attitude; impact with terrain; all 7 occupants killed
